# RAN2 session schedule fixtures

Retrieved 2026-10-05 (Asia/Seoul):

- `R2_135_Schedule_v11.docx`: https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/Meetings_3GPP_SYNC/RAN2/Agenda/R2_135_Schedule_v11.docx
  (final schedule of RAN2#135, Maastricht, 2026-08-24..28). Thursday uses shifted
  slots (10:50, 14:15, 16:40), Brk 2/3 split slots into sub-rows for offlines,
  the offline list below the table has 17 entries (two wrap onto a second
  line), and Friday's main cell has tracked insertions.
- `R2_135b_Schedule_v00.docx`: https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/tsg_ran/WG2_RL2/TSGR2_135bis/Agenda/R2_135b_Schedule_v00.docx
  (first schedule of RAN2#135bis, Seoul, 2026-10-12..16).
- `R2_131bis_Schedule v19.docx`: https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/tsg_ran/WG2_RL2/TSGR2_131bis/Agenda/R2_131bis_Schedule%20v19.docx
  (AI numbering one level higher, Monday's Main cell merged across two slots,
  many tracked changes such as "@11:00-1" corrected to "@11:00-12:00").
- `agenda_135.csv`, `agenda_135bis.csv`: `agenda.csv` from the TSGR2_135 and
  TSGR2_135bis `Agenda/` folders. The file name is fixed per folder and the
  content is regenerated, so these are snapshots.

Tests read these files without network access.
